descriptor.description:
Declare what this connector covers, how it is sourced, and what it does NOT cover.

Call this before telling a user that the law "does not contain" something, and whenever
a search comes back empty: the absence may be a gap in this connector rather than in the
law. Every gap carries a fallback saying where to look instead.

Returns:
    ``Coverage`` with families, an as-of note, and a non-empty list of known gaps.
descriptor.name: gb_coverage

outputSchema.description: What this connector covers, how it is sourced, and what it does not cover.

as_of_note.description: States what the dates mean, and what they do not promise.

items.description: One data family this connector exposes.

captured_at.description: Date this family was last captured (ISO). None when queried live.

live.description: True when queried live instead of from a snapshot.

source.description: Official source the data comes from.

tool.description: Tool or tools that reach this family.

known_gaps.description: Never empty. An empty list would mean 'not checked', not 'no gaps'.

items.description: A known, named hole in this connector's coverage - plus the way around it.

family.description: Which family the gap belongs to.

missing.description: What is NOT available through this connector.

descriptor.description: Fetch UK legislation metadata from legislation.gov.uk by reference.

reference.description:
a reference like ``"ukpga/2018/12"`` (Data Protection Act 2018),
``"uksi/2019/419"``, ``"asp/2015/1"``, or a full legislation.gov.uk URL.
An optional point-in-time date suffix (``/2026-06-19``) selects a specific
revised version.

descriptor.name: gb_get_act

dataset_note.default: legislation.gov.uk has no native /eli/ namespace; eli_uri carries the UK's own persistent identifier URI (id.../{type}/{year}/{number}) instead of a fabricated ELI path. Revised ('as amended') text reflects the effective date shown in restrict_start_date; always check for in-force / pending amendments.

descriptor.description: Fetch a UK judgment from The National Archives' Find Case Law service.

reference.description:
a neutral citation (e.g. ``"[2026] EWHC 1698 (Admin)"``), a Find Case
Law URI/path (e.g. ``"ewhc/admin/2026/1698"`` or a full
``caselaw.nationalarchives.gov.uk`` URL), or an opaque ``"d-{uuid}"`` id.
Neutral citations resolve directly to a URI only for pre-April-2025 documents
(``/{court}/{year}/{number}``); for later documents (opaque id), use
`gb_search_case_law` first to find the ``uri``.

descriptor.name: gb_get_case

dataset_note.default: caselaw.nationalarchives.gov.uk (Find Case Law, The National Archives) publishes judgments under the Open Justice Licence - a separate service from legislation.gov.uk (different host, no shared identifier scheme). Pre-April-2025 documents have a derivable URI ('/{court}/{year}/{number}'); documents from April 2025 onward use an opaque 'd-{uuid}' URI (fclid) that cannot be derived from the neutral citation alone. human_readable_citation is the neutral citation, e.g. '[2026] EWHC 1698 (Admin)'.

descriptor.description:
Fetch one GOV.UK document (tribunal decision, HMRC manual section, CMA case).

Maps to the GOV.UK Content API (``www.gov.uk/api/content/{path}`` - confirmed live
2026-07-07). Tribunal decisions carry the judgment as a PDF in ``attachments`` with
only a short HTML body; HMRC manual sections carry the full text in ``body_html``.

path.description:
the document's site path - take it from a ``gb_search_govuk`` result's
``link`` field, e.g.
``"/employment-tribunal-decisions/mr-b-king-v-thales-dis-uk-ltd-1403603-slash-2020"``
or ``"/hmrc-internal-manuals/vat-government-and-public-bodies/vatgpb9700"``.
A full ``www.gov.uk`` URL is also accepted.

descriptor.name: gb_get_govuk_content

items.description: An attachment on a GOV.UK document (e.g. a tribunal judgment PDF).

dataset_note.default: www.gov.uk Search API + Content API (keyless, Crown copyright, Open Government Licence v3.0) - one upstream aggregating many institutions' documents: employment tribunal decisions, employment appeal tribunal decisions, tax tribunal decisions, Upper Tribunal (AAC) decisions, residential property tribunal decisions, HMRC internal manuals, CMA competition cases and more (filter by document_type). GOV.UK documents have no neutral-citation or ELI scheme; human_readable_citation is '{Title} ({document type}, {date}, GOV.UK)'. Tribunal decisions carry the judgment as a PDF attachment with a short HTML body; HMRC manual sections carry the full text in body_html.

descriptor.description:
Fetch the full text of UK legislation.

Uses legislation.gov.uk's content-negotiation path suffix (``/data.{format}``) -
``xml`` (the site's own ``legislation.xsd`` schema), ``html``, ``akn`` (Akoma Ntoso),
``rdf``, ``pdf``, or ``csv``.

reference.description: reference of the act/instrument (work or point-in-time expression).

descriptor.name: gb_get_text

dataset_note.default: legislation.gov.uk has no native /eli/ namespace; eli_uri carries the UK's own persistent identifier URI (id.../{type}/{year}/{number}) instead of a fabricated ELI path. Revised ('as amended') text reflects the effective date shown in restrict_start_date; always check for in-force / pending amendments.

descriptor.description:
UK legislation published since ``since_iso`` (ISO 8601 date), newest-first.

Maps to the Atom search feed sorted/filtered by publication year, optionally scoped
to one ``doc_type``. legislation.gov.uk's public search feed does not support a
generic ``dateFrom`` filter across all types, so this tool filters the requested
year's feed by the ``published`` date client-side.

doc_type.description: restrict to one UK document-type code (e.g. ``"ukpga"``, ``"uksi"``).

since_iso.description:
a date in ISO 8601 (e.g. ``"2026-01-01"``). Only the year is used to
select the feed to scan; items are then filtered to on/after this date.

descriptor.name: gb_recent_legislation

descriptor.description:
Search UK legislation on legislation.gov.uk.

Maps to the official Atom search feed (``/all/data.feed`` or ``/{doc_type}/data.feed``,
optionally with ``?text=...&year=...&page=...``). Each item gets ``eli_uri``,
``human_readable_citation``, ``source_url`` (per Art. 4 CONSTITUTION).

doc_type.description: Restrict to one UK document-type code, e.g. 'ukpga', 'uksi', 'asp', 'nia', 'wsi'. Omit to search all types.

descriptor.name: gb_search

dataset_note.default: legislation.gov.uk has no native /eli/ namespace; eli_uri carries the UK's own persistent identifier URI (id.../{type}/{year}/{number}) instead of a fabricated ELI path. Revised ('as amended') text reflects the effective date shown in restrict_start_date; always check for in-force / pending amendments.

items.description: Lightweight legislation record - from a search/listing item.

doc_type.description: Restrict to one UK document-type code, e.g. 'ukpga', 'uksi', 'asp', 'nia', 'wsi'. Omit to search all types.

descriptor.description:
Search UK case law on The National Archives' Find Case Law service.

Maps to the public Atom feed at ``caselaw.nationalarchives.gov.uk/atom.xml``
(confirmed live 2026-07-06 - keyless, Open Justice Licence). A separate service from
legislation.gov.uk: different host, different Atom dialect (``tna:`` namespace).

court.description:
court/tribunal code, e.g. ``"ewhc/admin"``, ``"ewca/civ"``, ``"uksc"``.
Passed through to Find Case Law's own ``court`` query param.

from_date.description:
ISO 8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD), inclusive. Find Case Law's public API has
no documented server-side date-range filter, so this is applied client-side
against each result's ``date`` field after fetching.

query.description: full-text search (matches judgment text in order, per upstream docs).

to_date.description: ISO 8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD), inclusive. Same client-side caveat.

descriptor.name: gb_search_case_law

dataset_note.default: caselaw.nationalarchives.gov.uk (Find Case Law, The National Archives) publishes judgments under the Open Justice Licence - a separate service from legislation.gov.uk (different host, no shared identifier scheme). Pre-April-2025 documents have a derivable URI ('/{court}/{year}/{number}'); documents from April 2025 onward use an opaque 'd-{uuid}' URI (fclid) that cannot be derived from the neutral citation alone. human_readable_citation is the neutral citation, e.g. '[2026] EWHC 1698 (Admin)'.

items.description: Lightweight case-law record - from a Find Case Law search/feed item.

court.description: Court code, e.g. 'ewhc/admin', 'uksc', 'ukpc'. Omit to search all courts.

from_date.description: ISO 8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD), inclusive. Find Case Law's public API has no documented server-side date-range filter, so this is applied client-side against each result's 'date' field after fetching.

descriptor.description:
Search GOV.UK documents - tribunal decisions, HMRC manuals, CMA cases and more.

Maps to the GOV.UK Search API (``www.gov.uk/api/search.json`` - confirmed live
2026-07-07: keyless, Open Government Licence v3.0). One upstream aggregating many
institutions; filter with ``document_type``. Legally weighty types with live-verified
totals (2026-07-07): ``employment_tribunal_decision`` (132,162),
``hmrc_manual_section`` (85,315), ``residential_property_tribunal_decision``
(17,088), ``employment_appeal_tribunal_decision`` (2,571), ``cma_case`` (2,565),
``utaac_decision`` (2,031), ``tax_tribunal_decision`` (1,414),
``asylum_support_decision`` (101).

from_date.description:
ISO 8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD), inclusive - passed server-side via
``filter_public_timestamp`` (unlike Find Case Law, GOV.UK supports this).

to_date.description: ISO 8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD), inclusive. Same server-side filter.

descriptor.name: gb_search_govuk

dataset_note.default: www.gov.uk Search API + Content API (keyless, Crown copyright, Open Government Licence v3.0) - one upstream aggregating many institutions' documents: employment tribunal decisions, employment appeal tribunal decisions, tax tribunal decisions, Upper Tribunal (AAC) decisions, residential property tribunal decisions, HMRC internal manuals, CMA competition cases and more (filter by document_type). GOV.UK documents have no neutral-citation or ELI scheme; human_readable_citation is '{Title} ({document type}, {date}, GOV.UK)'. Tribunal decisions carry the judgment as a PDF attachment with a short HTML body; HMRC manual sections carry the full text in body_html.

items.description: Lightweight GOV.UK document record - from a Search API result.

document_type.description: GOV.UK content_store_document_type slug, e.g. 'employment_tribunal_decision', 'employment_appeal_tribunal_decision', 'tax_tribunal_decision', 'utaac_decision', 'residential_property_tribunal_decision', 'asylum_support_decision', 'hmrc_manual_section', 'cma_case'. Omit to search all of GOV.UK.
